definitions.explanation: A literary or cinematic work of medium length — longer than a short story or short film but shorter than a full-length novel or feature film.
The middle part of a multi-volume series, typically in a three-part ({上|じょう}{中|ちゅう}{下|げ}) structure.

examples.japanese: {中編|ちゅうへん}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中編|ちゅうへん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{六十|ろくじゅう}{分|ぷん}だ。
examples.english: This is a medium-length film, about sixty minutes.

examples.japanese: {中編|ちゅうへん}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{長編|ちょうへん}→長編：14475_chouhen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧だ。
examples.english: A novella is a length between a short story and a novel.

examples.japanese: {上編|じょうへん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧{中編|ちゅうへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read the middle volume after the first.

examples.japanese: {三部作|さんぶさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中編|ちゅうへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: The middle part of the trilogy is the most interesting.

examples.japanese: {中編|ちゅうへん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: The middle volume is scheduled for release next month.

notes:
Has two distinct uses: as a classification of work length (sense 1) and as a position in a multi-volume series (sense 2).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧: short work (short story, short film)
- ⟦{長編|ちょうへん}→長編：14475_chouhen⟧: long work (novel, feature film)
- {上編|じょうへん}: first volume / upper volume
- {下編|かへん}: final volume / lower volume

USAGE:
For sense 1, there is no strict page or word count definition, but a {中編|ちゅうへん}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (novella) is generally considered to be roughly 100-400 pages. For sense 2, {中編|ちゅうへん} is used interchangeably with {中巻|ちゅうかん} in some contexts.
